name: Levitate
prompt: The person floats a full meter above the ground, clearly hovering in midair, feet clearly off the floor and dangling, hair and clothes drifting weightlessly, dust and debris rising in the air beneath them, glowing telekinetic energy swirling around the body, cinematic VFX shot, the person stays in the same place and the camera, lighting and background match the original footage
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, warped body, flickering, watermark, text, subtitles, cartoon, deformed hands
